integrity: The source papers establish distinct static-reservoir or particle-type-switching results. The new all-pair crossover is proved here; finite generator checks corroborate rather than replace the all-size proof. Bibliographic completeness and independent validation are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite N >= 2 only; uniqueness of positive covariance crossing is proved only for N=2; endpoint limits are not uniform in N. The theorem assumes a unit-rate SSEP, left full bath and an autonomous symmetric switching right bath.
title: Universal correlation reversal under a switching boundary reservoir
